name: random+nodecay+sync-file-io+1-blocking-thread
setup_commands: command -v gcc >/dev/null || (sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y gcc libc6-dev)

printf '#include <stdio.h>\n#include <sys/random.h>\nint main(){unsigned char r[4];getrandom(r,4,0);printf("%%02x%%02x%%02x%%02x\\n",r[0],r[1],r[2],r[3]);return 0;}' > /tmp/detshim-probe.c && gcc -o /tmp/detshim-probe /tmp/detshim-probe.c && a=$(LD_PRELOAD="$VARIANCE_LAB_DIR/detshim.so" DETSHIM=random /tmp/detshim-probe) && b=$(LD_PRELOAD="$VARIANCE_LAB_DIR/detshim.so" DETSHIM=random /tmp/detshim-probe) && [ "$a" = "$b" ] && echo shim-ok $a
valgrind --sync-file-io=yes --version && VALGRIND_OPTS="$VALGRIND_OPTS" valgrind -q true && echo valgrind-opts-ok
